IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Wylie, Moscoso, Kirby, and Roberts

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an efficient and effective system for the taxation and tracking of recreational marijuana sales.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an efficient and effective system forthe taxation and tracking of recreational marijuana sales; creating anew section; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes theimportance of ensuring the collection of taxes on the production,processing, and sale of recreational marijuana. The legislaturefurther recognizes that a system must be created by the liquor controlboard to establish the most efficient and secure mechanism for thecollection and tracking of such taxes for both state and industry that: (a) Provides an efficient single collection point for recreationalmarijuana taxes that ensures all revenue is collected in the mostappropriate and effective manner possible; (b) Provides ease of administration and regulation; and (c) Requires the liquor control board to select and implement themost secure, convenient, and effective taxing and tracking system asquickly as possible. (2) The legislature further finds that the state would benefit fromhaving the taxing and tracking system created under this act be p. 1 HB 2786operational prior to the date that the first sale of recreationalmarijuana occurs in this state; and therefore, declares that suchsystem should be developed and implemented as soon as possible toensure efficient and effective tax collection.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
